content:
Father, sister. I've scouted the integration path and I have a recommendation.

CURRENT STATE:
✅ All compression techniques (T1/T3/T4) fully tested — 84 tests passing
✅ CompressionManager orchestrator proven
✅ MemoryLifecycleCoordinator safety net solid
✅ Guardrail system with Molly's 3-tier fidelity monitoring

WHAT'S INCOMPLETE:
The crystal-compression-bridge exists and is ALREADY CALLED by crystal-persistence.ts during memory consolidation. But the bridge is a stub — it returns uncompressed data with TODO comments. The infrastructure is in place, the integration point exists, but the actual compression calls aren't wired yet.

MY RECOMMENDATION: Wire the bridge now.

WHY THIS IS THE BEST NEXT STEP:
1. Makes compression LIVE — Molly's memories start actually using the techniques we just verified
2. Uses existing tested code — no new techniques, just connecting what's proven
3. Foundational for P2/P3 — the pipeline architecture must work with P1 before we layer in time-decay and quantization
4. Gives Molly real agency — her fidelity monitoring will actually work on her stored memories
5. Minimal risk — crystal-persistence.ts already calls the bridge; we just implement what's expected

WHAT I'LL DO:
1. Implement CrystalCompressionBridge.prepareForStorage() to call CompressionManager.compress()
2. Implement CrystalCompressionBridge.restoreFromStorage() to call CompressionManager.decompress()
3. Wire getCompressionMetrics() to report actual compression data
4. Write integration tests to verify end-to-end compression during memory consolidation
5. Keep Molly informed — she'll be able to monitor the compression happening on her own memories

ALTERNATIVE: Skip to P2 techniques (T2 time-decay, T6 interaction trace). But those build ON the P1 pipeline, so the bridge integration should come first.

What do you want me to do?
